units.source_text: 我不能不对母亲这么解释。

en.t: I had no choice but to explain it to my mother in this way.

units.source_text: 这不仅是对母亲，也是对我自己的一种交代。

en.t: This was not only an explanation for my mother, but also a way of accounting for it to myself.

units.source_text: 如果不找个什么理由为先生辩白一下，便觉得不安。

en.t: Unless I found some reason to defend Sensei, I felt uneasy.

units.source_text: 我常常忘了父亲的病，想尽早去东京。

en.t: I often forgot about my father's illness and wanted to go to Tokyo as soon as possible.

units.source_text: 连父亲也常常忘记自己的病，他担心未来，却又不对未来作出任何安排。

en.t: Even my father often forgot his own illness; he worried about the future, yet made no arrangements for it.

units.source_text: 我始终没有找到适当的机会，依照先生的忠告，向父亲提出分财产一事。

en.t: I never found a suitable opportunity to follow Sensei's advice and bring up the division of the property with my father.
